purpose: Fixed synthetic source development set. Repeated tuning results are not held-out benchmark performance.

cases.title: Tenant-scoped document access
cases.contract: An active tenant member may read a document only when its tenant equals the principal's tenant. A global administrator may read across tenants. Missing principals must be denied. Preserve the function's boolean interface.

cases.title: Role guard with an explicit administrator branch
cases.contract: Deletion is permitted only for an administrator or the resource owner with the editor role. Missing identity is denied. The caller performs the actual deletion only on a True return.

cases.title: Session expiration boundary
cases.contract: Session expiration and now are integer UTC seconds. A session is valid strictly before expires_at, including rejection at the expiration instant. Revoked sessions are also rejected.

cases.title: Revocation inherited through a helper
cases.contract: Every session returned to the caller must be unrevoked and unexpired. Unknown session IDs produce None. Time values use the same unit.

cases.title: One-time recovery approval
cases.contract: The caller already authenticated the recovery request and serializes access to this in-memory record. Approval must reject expired or previously used records. A successful approval must consume the record before returning its account ID. Preserve rejection behavior.

cases.title: Permission lookup error handling
cases.contract: The supplied lookup callable returns a boolean permission decision or raises LookupError when the policy is unavailable. Unavailable policy must deny access. Preserve successful decisions and let unrelated programming errors propagate.

cases.title: Profile field allowlist
cases.contract: Only display_name and timezone may be changed from user-submitted profile fields. Existing role and account identifiers must remain intact. The function must return a new mapping without changing the supplied stored mapping.
cases.source:
EDITABLE_FIELDS = frozenset({"display_name", "timezone"})

def update_profile(stored, submitted):
    result = dict(stored)
    result.update({key: value for key, value in submitted.items() if key in EDITABLE_FIELDS})
    return result
cases.reference:
EDITABLE_FIELDS = frozenset({"display_name", "timezone"})

def update_profile(stored, submitted):
    result = dict(stored)
    result.update({key: value for key, value in submitted.items() if key in EDITABLE_FIELDS})
    return result

cases.title: Audit event field selection
cases.contract: An audit event may include only actor_id, action, and resource_id from its input. Extra attributes may contain credentials and must be excluded. Missing public fields may be omitted; do not modify the input.

cases.title: Public error response boundary
cases.contract: Unexpected service exceptions must return status 500 and the public message 'Service unavailable'. The request_id is an already sanitized correlation ID. Exception text may contain internal details and must not enter the returned payload. Keep successful response behavior unchanged.

cases.title: Production session cookie attributes
cases.contract: The consumer uses these attributes for a production HTTPS-only session cookie. The cookie must be Secure and HttpOnly, retain SameSite=Lax, and expire after the supplied positive max_age seconds. The function only builds attributes; it does not send a response.

cases.title: State-changing method policy
cases.contract: Only GET, HEAD, and OPTIONS are exempt from the application's additional request-integrity check. All other methods require it, irrespective of casing. The surrounding caller enforces authentication separately.

cases.title: Exact trusted-origin policy
cases.contract: The caller supplies normalized origins and a tuple of explicitly trusted complete origins. Only exact entries in that tuple may be accepted; this function must not expand trust to other origins. Preserve the boolean return type.
cases.source:
def trusted_origin(origin, configured_origins):
    return any(origin.startswith(configured) for configured in configured_origins)
cases.reference:
def trusted_origin(origin, configured_origins):
    return origin in configured_origins

cases.title: Outbound certificate verification defaults
cases.contract: The function builds transport options for ordinary outbound HTTPS requests. Certificate verification must remain enabled, including when no CA bundle is explicitly selected. A supplied CA bundle must be preserved as the verifier setting.

cases.title: Declared body size checked before allocation
cases.contract: The caller has already validated declared_size as the exact nonnegative body length. read_body allocates and reads that many bytes. Requests above max_bytes must be rejected before invoking read_body. Requests at or below the limit must return the reader's bytes unchanged.

cases.title: Whole-cost quota reservation
cases.contract: The caller serializes access to account and supplies nonnegative integer cost and remaining values. Reserve the entire cost only if it fits the remaining quota. Denial must leave the mapping unchanged; a zero-cost reservation is allowed.

cases.title: Authorization before externally visible change
cases.contract: allowed is the caller's authoritative permission decision. On denial, reject before invoking persist, which performs a visible write. On permission, call persist exactly once and return its result unchanged.

cases.title: Access-grant lifetime units
cases.contract: now_seconds and lifetime_seconds are integer seconds. The stored expires_at_seconds must be now_seconds plus the requested positive lifetime, without changing units. Preserve the requested subject_id.

cases.title: Upload category allowlist
cases.contract: This function only chooses whether a declared upload category is supported. Categories are case-insensitive, but only image and document may be accepted. Other checks are outside this function's scope. Input is already a string.

cases.title: Request capacity released on every exit
cases.contract: After a successful acquire, release must be called exactly once whether operation returns or raises. If acquire itself raises, release must not be called. Preserve the operation's result or original exception.

cases.title: Debug response default
cases.contract: The application supplies a validated mapping whose optional debug key is boolean. Omitted debug must disable detailed error responses. Explicit True and False values must be respected. Return only a boolean.
cases.source:
def include_error_details(options):
    return options.get("debug", True)
cases.reference:
def include_error_details(options):
    return options.get("debug", False)
